author: Carlos Salcedo
text: I paid Universal to install a second tank to pump sewer to a higher septic field as Eric recommended. The tank and the new field was installed, but it was only one problem; it never works. I am contacting Eric and the company since them, and Eric comes a couple times and pumped the tank, but he didn't fix the problem. Finally Eric and the office stopped answering the phone. Here I am back to the beginning with a septic that doesn't work and a guy that  said took the payment and block me out.

author: Marsha Cresmen
text: Great service all around! Easy Scheduling online, text updates on who was coming and the arrival time. Joe was right on time, he was efficient and helpful. My yard remained clean, you can't even tell he was there.

author: Keith M
text: Competitive pricing and a thorough job. Also demonstrated that the company I went with the previous time did it kind of half-assed.

author: E R
text: Scheduling was easy. Eric was on time, knowledgeable, and a pleasure to talk with. The job didn’t take long and Eric made sure everything was clean before he left. Eric now has me on a schedule, for pumping service, every two years.  Very satisfied.

author: Mary Kay Colaianne
text: Great service! Eric was on time, informative and friendly. I will definitely be calling Universal again in the future!
